research_window.note: Continuous research coverage begins at the prior release's preserved UTC boundary and ends at this run's evidence cutoff.

dedupe_resolutions.notes: Vance's end-times statement was made in a broad faith interview and did not explicitly concern Iran or any particular official act. It remains a distinct governance and risk-framing statement rather than being merged into the Iran/Hormuz war record.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

The shared White House fact sheet reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One record concerns announced company agreements; the other concerns an administration-reported program measurement.

The August employment release is an independently measured economic outcome. Trump's subsequent trade threat used the report as context but is a distinct presidential risk statement with no implementing instrument; neither record substitutes for the other.

The September 4 orders direct ranching, competition, processing, wolf and labeling actions. The August 26 proclamation separately implemented a temporary lean-beef import quota increase; the instruments and outcome tests are distinct.

The national measles surveillance outcome concerns a vaccine-preventable infectious disease. The August 31 newborn record measures vitamin K nonreceipt, which is not a vaccine and involves a different intervention, population and outcome.

LEG-004706 records the June 22 district-court summary judgment vacating modified SAVE. The new record covers the September 4 appellate refusal to stay that judgment and the expedited merits appeal; both stages remain cross-referenced under the same litigation.

The Central African Republic record covers a second implemented flight to that country. The Guyana record covers the first implemented group under a separate bilateral arrangement, different people and different post-transfer terms.

The Liberia record documents a separate agreement and capacity announcement. The Guyana record documents actual arrival of a different six-person group under a one-year temporary arrangement; neither is a duplicate of the other.

The September 4 record concerns a conditional threat to restrict trade with unspecified deficit countries if the Federal Reserve did not cut rates. The September 7 Bombardier statement names one company, ties U.S. market access to domestic manufacturing and arises in a separate Canada aviation dispute; neither threat had an implementing instrument by its cutoff.

rejected_candidates.title: Equatorial Guinea police confrontation with U.S. deportees
rejected_candidates.reason: Reuters reviewed video and interviewed witnesses concerning an alleged armed confrontation, but the consequential account was not independently confirmed by a second outlet or an official incident record by cutoff. It remains queued rather than presented as established.

rejected_candidates.title: Houthi attacks injuring 73 people in Saudi Arabia
rejected_candidates.reason: Reuters and AP independently reported a serious regional escalation, but the inspected evidence still did not establish a resulting U.S. order, operation, commitment or other Trump-administration lifecycle change.

rejected_candidates.title: Trump-Putin call and positive Ukraine diplomacy descriptions
rejected_candidates.reason: The Kremlin reported a constructive call and continued interest in prisoner exchanges, while Zelenskyy praised U.S. ideas; no proposal text, exchange agreement, ceasefire, security guarantee or territorial settlement resulted by cutoff. The separately measured resumption of Kyiv attacks was incorporated into the existing record.

rejected_candidates.title: Huawei sanctions-evasion and racketeering trial
rejected_candidates.reason: Jury selection began in a long-running prosecution initiated years earlier. The disputed allegations, procedural trial start and absence of a verdict did not establish a new Trump-administration policy or enforcement decision.

rejected_candidates.title: Iceland summons U.S. ambassador over Trump map post
rejected_candidates.reason: The diplomatic protest concerned an image post and did not produce a verified U.S. order, territorial claim instrument or implementing action.

rejected_candidates.title: Unconfirmed Iranian U.S. drone-loss claim
rejected_candidates.reason: No current U.S. confirmation or sufficiently corroborated independent evidence was found for the reported claim; it was not promoted into the Iran/Hormuz record.

rejected_candidates.title: Truth Social fallback
rejected_candidates.reason: No new post appeared after the prior validated snapshot. Engagement-only changes do not create a new content review or canonical record.

rejected_candidates.title: Routine notices, construction and duplicate follow-ups
rejected_candidates.reason: Technical Federal Register notices, ceremonial White House construction coverage and repeated reporting without a material new lifecycle stage were withheld rather than used to pad the archive.

rejected_candidates.title: Legacy quality batch
rejected_candidates.reason: The three surfaced same-date pairs and current source-health queue were reviewed again; no objective record-specific correction beyond the current-layer boat attribution fix was supported strongly enough to alter canonical history.

rejected_candidates.title: External archive discovery leads
rejected_candidates.reason: All four registered archives were checked and their measures remain separate by unit. No external item was promoted without original-source inspection, complete reasoning review and duplicate clearance.
